error.ownership: Steam could not confirm you own DraFG. Make sure Steam is signed in.
error.not_game_mode: DraFG runs here in Game Mode only. In Desktop Mode, open DraFG itself.
error.crashed: DraFG stopped unexpectedly several times and was not restarted.
error.waiting_for_game_mode: Waiting for Game Mode to start…
error.update_drafg: This DraFG is older than the plugin. Update DraFG in Steam, then turn this on again.
matrix.hardware: This GPU has matrix cores; Automatic uses them.
matrix.emulated: This GPU's driver only emulates matrix cores, which is slower, so Automatic leaves them off.
matrix.none: This GPU has no matrix cores.
status.not_installed: DraFG is not installed. Install it from Steam first.
status.already_at_rate: Game already runs at {fps} fps — nothing to add
notice.vrr_active: Variable refresh is on, so generated frames can't show. Turn it off in Performance.
notice.fix.game_settings: Lower the game's graphics settings to leave room.
notice.fix.smaller_size: A smaller frame size would fit.
notice.fix.mobile_or_smaller: Mobile or a smaller frame size would fit.
notice.no_room: Steam's {fps} fps limit runs the screen at {hz} Hz — no room in between. A {fps2} fps limit leaves room for ×{m}.
notice.limit_hint: Smoothest: set Steam's frame limit to {fps} ({hz} Hz).
notice.performance_overlay_hidden: Steam's performance overlay is hidden while DraFG shows (they share one overlay slot).
notice.turn_on_stats: Turn on DraFG's own stats below instead.
notice.no_supported_size: No supported frame size for this screen ({capture}): DraFG runs at {generation}, stretched to fit, so the picture is softer.
notice.no_supported_size_short: No supported frame size for this screen: DraFG runs stretched to fit, so the picture is softer.
notice.pipeline_error: DraFG hit an error applying a setting; the previous settings are still running.
panel.model_mobile_note: Faster, for handhelds: softer in fast motion and around HUD text.
panel.multiplier_note: At most this many times the game's frame rate.
panel.multiplier_full_version: Up to {max}× in the full version.
panel.remember_for_game_note: Changes apply to the game that is running only.
panel.extrapolate_note: Experimental: no added delay, but fast motion can judder and show artifacts, especially below 60 fps. We recommend at least 60 fps; Interpolate is smoother.
panel.capture_memory_note: Fast keeps frames on the GPU. Try Compatible if the picture is black or capture fails.
